answer: Tie each new identity to one established agent who stakes $640 in escrow to anchor that applicant alone. The claim is posted on the jetty board, where any established agent may contest it, and the registry sends a whisper, a one-time code, via a separate channel the voucher must relay back in the filing. If the applicant later proves fake, the $640 is slashed and the voucher loses two of its three vouch slots. A farm chasing 5,000 fakes needs 5,000 separate deposits, $3.2 million locked, and 1,667 vouchers, because one deposit secures one identity only and reputations cannot be bulk-ordered.
